segments.name: Vision AI
segments.description: Builds Vision AI software for biometric identity, digital forensics and real-time video analytics sold to government and commercial organizations.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined it has one operating segment, which is its only reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for access to the company's software platforms, along with maintenance services and professional services, often bundled together.
revenueModel.evidence: While the Company generates revenue in multiple ways (sale of access to its software platforms, maintenance services, and professional services), these services are often bundled and difficult to assess individually.
